resultSchema.description: Semantic Rails MCP result envelope. Tool-specific fields are additive; the status, issue, request, and package fields are stable v2.

tools.description: Rank semantic objects against business terms (e.g. 'revenue', 'aov by store'). Returns measures, metrics, dimensions, and entities, up to 'limit' per kind; empty terms list ids per kind instead, 100 at a time (limit, offset). Default: slim cards (id, label, description); compact keeps slim cards and omits blocked candidates. Gotcha: nonsense terms return 'out_of_scope' or 'low_relevance' with empty buckets; branch before using a candidate.

kinds.description: Object kinds to rank, such as measure or metric. Default: all.

limit.description: Per kind (default 10); with empty terms, ids per kind (default 100).

offset.description: With empty terms, ids to skip per kind.

query.description: A partial query call (execute's query schema) to start from.

stage.description: Builder stage that tunes ranking: initial, post_measure, post_dimension or comparison. Inferred when omitted.

tools.name: discover

outputSchema.description: Semantic Rails MCP v2 result envelope.

tools.description: Return one object's card: label, description, aggregations or values, temporal roles, related objects, policy. Default: the card without duplicate fields; verbosity='compact' returns the full card. Gotcha: 'object_id' must be a full id like 'measure.sales.revenue', not a label — use 'discover' first if you only have a phrase.

query.description: A partial query call (execute's query schema) to start from.

tools.name: inspect

outputSchema.description: Semantic Rails MCP v2 result envelope.

tools.description: Return a dimension's governed values: from its declared value domain, or from a constrained warehouse probe with allow_live_query: true. Use it before writing a 'where' filter on a categorical dimension. Gotcha: 'dimension_id' must be a full id like 'dimension.store_name'; allow_live_query costs a warehouse round-trip, so use it only when no domain is declared.

include_counts.description: With allow_live_query, add each value's row count.

query.description: A partial query call (execute's query schema) to start from.

tools.name: valid-values

outputSchema.description: Semantic Rails MCP v2 result envelope.

tools.description: Draft one best query call from a natural-language intent; call it before 'execute' instead of writing a call from scratch. Returns 'status' ('ok' | 'low_confidence' | 'unrealizable' | 'out_of_scope'), 'best.query_ir', and 'why' or 'warnings' naming any part of the question the draft doesn't honor. detail='query' (default) is compact; 'best' adds intent_ir, trace and next steps; 'full' adds alternatives and blocked drafts; 'debug' adds compose_hints. Gotcha: pass 'best.query_ir' to 'execute' only when status is 'ok' and there are no warnings.

limit.description: Drafts to consider; detail='full' returns the runners-up.

now.description: ISO date or date-time that relative windows (time.last, time.this) resolve against; default: the current time.

query.description: A partial query call (execute's query schema) to start from.

tools.name: plan

outputSchema.description: Semantic Rails MCP v2 result envelope.

parts.description: One plan per part of a question asking several things.

tools.description: Answer a query call; call plan first to draft it. mode 'run' returns rows; 'validate' only checks the call; 'sql' adds rendered_sql; only 'run' reads the warehouse, and a call that already ran needs no validate. The query schema is the call: select ids or {expression, as}, group_by dimension ids (alone, it lists rows), where/having [{field, op, value}], time (time.end is exclusive), order_by, limit. Pass now to pin relative windows.

max_rows.description: Rows to return in mode 'run'. A larger result sets truncated=true; the rest is not counted (total_row_count null).

now.description: ISO date or date-time that relative windows (time.last, time.this) resolve against; default: the current time.

query.description: A question for Semantic Rails. Identity comes from credentials and now is an argument beside the call; neither travels in it.

end.description: ISO date or date-time, exclusive: [start, end).

row_format.description: Execute row shape. 'records' (default)=rows as objects; 'columns'=columns plus array rows, avoiding repeated field names.

sql_profile.description: SQL rendering: 'audit'(default)/'compact'/'debug' format rendered_sql; 'off' suppresses rendered_sql + sql_plan entirely.

verbosity.description: 'minimal' (default): outcome, errors, warnings; SQL in 'sql', rows in 'run'. 'compact' adds metadata without plans; 'full' adds plans. All modes share a budget; omitted_fields lists trimmed detail.

tools.name: execute

outputSchema.description: Semantic Rails MCP v2 result envelope.

tools.description: Work with a package-authored segment, after discover finds its id: action='validate' checks it and the query derived from it, 'explain' adds the SQL, and 'preview' returns sample member rows and the total member count. Default verbosity='minimal' leaves out compiler plans; 'full' returns them. Gotcha: 'segment_id' must be a full id like 'segment.high_value_customers' (discover with empty terms lists them); 'preview' queries the warehouse.
tools.name: segment

outputSchema.description: Semantic Rails MCP v2 result envelope.
